description: Presidential Secretariat - Order to enlarge the time from 31.07.2018 upto 31.12.2018 for rendering the final report on Commission of Inquiry that published Gaz. No. 2056/41.
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the extension of a Commission of Inquiry's reporting deadline through presidential authority under the Commission of Inquiry Act. It deals with legal procedures, statutory timelines, and the formal extension of a legal investigation period, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
